description: Facing a compressed, weather-dependent departure window (woken with under an hour's notice that the charter plane was fuelling), the crew executed a standardized set of 'final tasks' — stowing bear mirrors, covering and disassembling the incinerator, fuel-stabilizing and sheltering the main generator, tarping the last ATV, and disconnecting and stowing Starlink — completing habitat shutdown and reaching the runway on foot in time to meet the plane.
response: All final tasks were completed within roughly an hour of waking; the crew departed successfully on the delayed charter window.
lesson: Maintain a named, rehearsed 'final tasks' checklist (distinct from routine daily shutdown) for imminent, short-notice departure, since weather-dependent Arctic charter windows can open with under an hour's warning.
